subject.title: Telegram polling-liveness monitor fires "⚠️ 🔌 Gateway failed" on non-fatal tool-call rejections

question: Should this be fixed as a default wording/classification repair only, or should Telegram also add a new alert-severity config option for fatal-only filtering?
rationale: The misleading default looks like a real bug, but the proposed config knob is a new user-facing configuration surface and AGENTS.md sets a high bar for adding those.

options.title: Default classification only
options.body: Repair the existing tool/progress wording so protected-path and approval-style rejections are visibly non-fatal and include useful context without adding config.

options.title: Add severity filtering too
options.body: Add a Telegram alert-severity option with schema, docs, tests, and upgrade proof if maintainers want operator-controlled suppression.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Leave the generic failed-tool wording as-is and document the current workaround, accepting the continued confusion risk.

recommendation.title: Default classification only
recommendation.body: Repair the existing tool/progress wording so protected-path and approval-style rejections are visibly non-fatal and include useful context without adding config.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history points obviyus to the affected agent/tool progress and Telegram-adjacent paths.
